(() => {
    const input = document.querySelector(".cards-tools input");
    const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".id-card"));
    input === null || input === void 0 ? void 0 : input.addEventListener("input", () => {
        const query = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        cards.forEach((card) => {
            var _a;
            card.hidden = !!query && !((_a = card.textContent) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : "").toLowerCase().includes(query);
        });
    });
})();
